question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
-- Full result with interest names
WITH peak AS (
  SELECT 
    im.interest_id,
    im.month_year,
    im.composition,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC) as rn
  FROM interest_metrics im
  WHERE im.month_year IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    p.interest_id,
    p.month_year,
    p.composition,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.composition DESC) as top_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.composition ASC) as bottom_rank
  FROM peak p
)
SELECT 
  r.month_year,
  im.interest_name,
  r.composition
FROM ranked r
JOIN interest_map im ON CAST(im.id AS DOUBLE) = r.interest_id
WHERE r.top_rank <= 10 OR r.bottom_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.composition DESC
